messages:
maya: heads-upwe had a noisy NA/EU flap overnight. going to propose two orthogonal mitigations: decision hysteresis (multi-window confirmation) and probe backpressure (tokens + cooldown) to stop probe storms during instability. attaching short notes.
sam: +1 on hysteresis. my worry: added latency for true failures. what thresholds allow prompt failover for critical tenants?
liam: product SLOs matter. maybe tiered hysteresis: gold tenants get 1-window fast path, default gets 2, sandbox gets 3. windows are small (3-5s).
maya: exactly. model: required_consecutive_windows per tier + critical_delta_override where a huge latency delta skips hysteresis.
emily: on probe backpressure: instead of increasing global probe frequency we issue per-tenant probe tokens. router requests tokens when it suspects instability; control plane grants limited bursts and enforces cooldowns. avoids global storms.
raj: implementation sketch for tokens: each tenant has a token bucket with capacity B, refill R per minute. when router sees variance it consumes tokens to increase probe rate for that tenant. if empty, router uses cached metrics and hysteresis rules.
nate: ops implications: we'll need new telemetry: token_consumption_rate, token_starvation_count, hysteresis_blocks, forced_failovers. add alerts for token_starvation spikes.
sam: decision data size is important. propose decision blob include minimal fields and a ttl so runtime doesn't query compiler every cycle. example: 

```n
{"allowed_regions":["eu","na"],"soft_penalties":{"na":0.12},"version":"2026-03-10-1","ttl_ms":60000}
```

runtime merges blob with live probes and hysteresis checks.
liam: also add a "gravity" field to blob to indicate how strongly compiler prefers a region (0-1). runtime can weigh gravity vs live penalty to break ties.
emily: +1. also we should sign blobs and include a blob_version header so routers can ignore stale blobs quickly. blob TTL + version solves long-tail staleness.
maya: ops-bot reported the incident:
ops-bot: Incident summary: 1761002105 - repeated failovers eu1 <-> na2 during probe spike; auto-fallback triggered for tenant 'finco' at 1761002120; duration: 9m; estimated user tail latency impact +0.7%.
maya: proposal: rollout plan
1) runtime: implement hysteresis windows + critical_delta_override + per-tenant knob to opt out (for very latency-sensitive customers).
2) control-plane: implement probe token service and per-tenant token buckets.
3) compiler: emit lightweight decision blob with allowed_regions, soft_penalties, gravity, version, ttl_ms, signature.
4) observability: add metrics and dashboard panels for token consumption, hysteresis deferrals, blob_version distribution, forced_failover_count.
5) test: build sim harness to replay the eu1 spike and validate no thrash under several token/hysteresis configurations.
sam: i'll take the runtime hysteresis PR + sim harness. will instrument counters for deferrals.
emily: i'll spec the blob format and implement serializer + signing proto. will drop a PR for review by EOD Friday.
raj: i'll prototype token-service and the bucket semantics. will include simple backoff jitter.
nate: i'll wire alerts and dashboards; add routing for per-tenant console knobs so Sales can flip for customers.
liam: one more thought: add a kill-switch per-region on routers to force immediate local-only routing during massive network partitions. console-only toggle for SRE.
maya: good call. keep defaults conservative. action owners as above. aim to canary the runtime change in staging next week and prod the control-plane token service in two sprints. thanks all. :rocket:
